inlines.v: CONSUMMATE, verb transitive [Latin See Sum.] To end; to finish by completing what was intended; to perfect; to bring or carry to the utmost point or degree. He had a mind to consummate the happiness of the day. CONSUMMATE, adjective Complete; perfect; carried to the utmost extent or degree; as consummate greatness or felicity.
